links.comparator_used: Pathologists scoring PD-L1 CPS on the microscope without the AI overlay (unassisted reads)
links.outcome: Interobserver agreement on PD-L1 CPS scoring of difficult gastroesophageal biopsy regions, and positive calls at CPS ≥ 5
links.effect: Agreement between any 2 pathologists rose by 14% (77% vs 91%). Agreement among 11 pathologists rose by 26% (43% vs 69%). Cases called positive by all 11 pathologists at CPS ≥ 5 increased by 31%.
links.quote: Using difficult to interpret regions on gastroesophageal biopsies, we show that AI-assistance improved case agreement between any 2 pathologists by 14% (agreement on 77% vs 91%) and among 11 pathologists by 26% (agreement on 43% vs 69%).

design_hint: AI assistance with pathologist-in-the-loop review via augmented reality microscope
